title: Banks Act Directive D6/2025 — Returns to be submitted to the Prudential Authority with effect from 1 July 2025
enablingLegislation: Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: This directive is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Returns to be submitted to the Prudential Authority with effect from 1 July 2025.

sections.heading: Application
sections.text: This directive applies to all banks, branches of foreign institutions and controlling companies registered or operating in South Africa in terms of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Returns to be submitted to the Prudential Authority with effect from 1 July 2025.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Returns to be submitted to the Prudential Authority with effect from 1 July 2025. Institutions are required to ensure compliance with the requirements set out herein. This directive remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.
